idea: Animals & their sounds #1 (GRANDMA'S FARM): a big friendly cow pops her head over the white fence right beside Baby Jimmy ('Wow! A big cow! Moo, moo!'); he moos back (say it with me: moo!); a fluffy white sheep trots up ('The sheep says baa!'); a little brown hen hops onto the fence post ('Cluck, cluck, cluck!') and Jimmy flaps his arms like wings (copy-me); then all three stand with him and Jimmy asks the viewer 'Who says moo? Hmm?' (pause) – 'The cow! Moo, moo!'; lesson 'Every animal has its own sound!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now cow, hen and sheep together and a bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! A Big Cow Says Moo! 🐮 Farm Animal Sounds with Baby Jimmy | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A big friendly cow pops up right next to Baby Jimmy at Grandma's farm – moo! 🐮 Then a fluffy sheep and a little hen come to say hello. Sing along and learn farm animal sounds with Jimmy!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! A big cow!" – the cow says moo
🗣️ Say it with me: moo, moo!
🐑 A fluffy sheep says baa, baa!
🐔 A little hen says cluck, cluck – flap your wings with Jimmy!
🤔 "Who says moo?" – can you answer?
👋 Every animal has its own sound! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: farm animal sounds • cow – moo • sheep – baa • hen – cluck • English words: cow, sheep, hen

A fun sing-along cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about farm animals and the sounds they make, with Baby Jimmy at Grandma's farm.
